sql: CREATE TABLE _cf_ALARM (scope TEXT PRIMARY KEY, at_ms INTEGER, retry INTEGER DEFAULT 0, counted_retry INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
CREATE TABLE _cf_FACETS (scope TEXT NOT NULL, path TEXT NOT NULL, image BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(scope,path)) WITHOUT ROWID
CREATE TABLE _cf_KV (scope TEXT, k TEXT, v TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(scope,k))
CREATE TABLE _cf_METADATA (scope TEXT PRIMARY KEY, actor_name TEXT)

CREATE TABLE _cf_WAKE (
           scope TEXT PRIMARY KEY, epoch TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(epoch)=16),
           sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(sequence)='integer' AND sequence>=0),
           at_ms INTEGER
         )
CREATE TABLE _litestream_seq (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, seq INTEGER)
